editorial:
Imagine you and your best friend are just trying to get through the day, but you end up making a huge mistake that leads to someone's death. That is exactly how things kick off here. You follow two messy characters who are already struggling with their lives, and they think they can just run away from their problems. They end up at a creepy roadside antique shop where an older woman seems like a lifesaver at first. The vibe starts out like a tense road trip movie, but it quickly shifts into a scary game of cat and mouse that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

The acting is great because the leads feel like real people you might know, making their panic feel authentic. While the first half moves a bit slow, the second half is a wild ride with some shocks you won't see coming. If you enjoy movies where normal people get into bad situations, you should definitely check this one out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, so make sure you stream it in the highest quality possible. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the shop owner isn't just a weird lady, but a serial killer who collects people like her antiques. She traps the friends in the basement, but one of them manages to fight back. After a brutal struggle, the survivor kills her and burns the shop down to hide the evidence. The movie ends with the survivor driving away, knowing they are now just as broken as the woman they killed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and twisted plot twists.
